FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'Here is my grandfather.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.
   B. Voici mon grand-père.
   C. C'est le bébé.
   D. Mon père s'appelle David.

2. How do you say 'The cat is under the chair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Où est le chat ?
   B. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   C. Le chat est sous la chaise.
   D. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.

3. What does 'derrière' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. in
   C. in front of
   D. behind

4. What number is 'vingt-cinq' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 12

5. What number is 'quinze' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 15

6. How do you say 'My birthday is on 12 May.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Voici un cadeau pour toi.
   B. J'ai dix ans.
   C. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.
   D. Joyeux anniversaire !

7. What does 'l'orange' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the orange
   B. the carrot
   C. tea
   D. water

8. How do you say 'What is it?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'aime le lait.
   B. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
   C. Ce sont des oranges.
   D. Je mange une mangue.

9. How do you say 'They are mangoes.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   B. Je bois un jus.
   C. C'est une banane.
   D. Ce sont des mangues.

10. How do you say 'I have a mouth.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai deux pieds.
   B. J'ai une bouche.
   C. Il a les cheveux courts.
   D. Elle a les cheveux longs.

11. What does 'le doigt' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the eyes
   B. the head
   C. the tooth
   D. the finger

12. How do you say 'I have two feet.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai deux yeux.
   B. J'ai deux oreilles.
   C. J'ai une bouche.
   D. J'ai deux pieds.

13. How do you say 'Tomorrow the weather is nice.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il neige.
   B. Demain, il fait beau.
   C. Il fait chaud.
   D. Il fait beau.

14. What does 'Il fait froid.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is raining.
   B. The weather is nice.
   C. It is cloudy.
   D. It is cold.

15. Which little word goes with 'sœur' (the sister)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. les
   C. l'
   D. le

16. What does 'Qui est-ce ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my mother.
   B. This is my sister.
   C. This is my brother.
   D. Who is it?

17. Which little word goes with 'famille' (the family)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. la
   D. l'

18. What does 'Mets le livre dans la chambre.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   B. There is a sofa in the living room.
   C. The cat is under the chair.
   D. Put the book in the bedroom.

19. What does 'Il est grand.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two eyes.
   B. She has black hair.
   C. I have a mouth.
   D. He is tall.

20. Fill in: ______ grand-mère s'appelle Grace. (1 mark)
   A. Ma
   B. Le
   C. Mon
   D. Un

21. How do you say 'Put' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le lit
   B. Mets
   C. sous
   D. le chat

22. How do you say 'the cat' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le chat
   B. la porte
   C. le livre
   D. la cuisine

23. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'sofa'? (1 mark)
   A. canapé
   B. caapé
   C. canapè
   D. canape

24. How do you write the number 16 in French? (1 mark)
   A. huit
   B. quatorze
   C. seize
   D. trente et un

25. How do you say 'a present' in French? (1 mark)
   A. un ballon
   B. un gâteau
   C. un cadeau
   D. un anniversaire

26. How do you write the number 31 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trente et un
   B. onze
   C. treize
   D. dix-neuf

27. How do you say 'the carrot' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pain
   B. le poulet
   C. l'orange
   D. la carotte

28. How do you say 'maize' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la mangue
   B. les bonbons
   C. les frites
   D. le maïs

29. How do you say 'water' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le jus
   B. le pain
   C. les haricots
   D. l'eau

30. How do you say 'It is cold.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il pleut.
   B. Il fait beau.
   C. Il fait chaud.
   D. Il fait froid.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into French: 'I am nine years old.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Translate into French: 'It is cloudy.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Translate into French: 'I have a nose.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

34. Translate into French: 'They are oranges.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Write a five-line greeting card to a friend called Kamau in French. (5 marks) (5 marks)

36. Translate into English: 'Il fait chaud.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

37. Translate into French: 'Yes, I am fine.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

38. Write the French words for: I dance, I rest, the week (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Translate into French: 'This is my mother.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

40. Write four sentences in French about your family. Use mon or ma correctly. (4 marks) (4 marks)

41. Translate into English: 'Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Write the French words for: the grandfather, the grandmother, the sister (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'How do you spell it?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'On Sunday, I rest.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'It is good for your health.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'What is it?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'Who is it?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'C'est mon frère.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

2. C — Le chat est sous la chaise.

3. D — behind
   derrière means behind.

4. C — 25
   vingt-cinq means 25.

5. D — 15
   quinze means 15.

6. C — Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.
   My birthday is on 12 May. in French is Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.

7. A — the orange

29. D — l'eau

30. D — Il fait froid.
